name: cost-tracker
description: 💸 Reports Claude Code spend on three labelled axes — per-session lifetime, today across all sessions, free local-lane savings — from the statusline cost ledger. Period reports (today/week/month/since), per-day trend, category breakdowns, a statusline wrapper, learned caps and gateway fees. Calibrates daily total against the gateway's refusal figure; quarantines invalid records with diagnostics.
